purpose: Fresh production baseline before supplier commercial-fields v2 forward migrations and worker activation

observation.method: Supabase execute_sql connector; SELECT statements only

method: Each pricing statement derives eligible latest legacy rows per exact SKU/supplier, suppressing only supplier scopes with any pointer; valid published rows from the current pointer are included. All comparisons use PostgreSQL numeric, with a single round(buy_price*(1+margin/100),2).

Complete expected code sets generate true5000-row keyset anchors. Each of three rates is checked independently through BOTH existing admin(decimal margin) and portal(percentage margin) readers for108Geba and30328Corteco rows.

Per-audience semantic_md5 hashes all returned fields except total_count, in exact code order. Audience shapes differ, so admin and portal hashes are not expected to match each other. Before/after comparison must compare the same audience/profile.
Legacy and catalog hashes cover entire exact-brand tables; current release row hash excludes new commercial columns so additive NULL columns do not create a false data-change signal.

Juventa rate is freshly read from the exact customer row and resolved according to the current embedded-metadata fallback source. Only profile, customer UUID and typed/embedded numeric rate are stored.
All32 existing legacy brand scopes in this organization were inventoried; total historical rows=1146602. The strict-field preflight scans all527452 active rows.

conceptualMigrationAssessment.newHistoricalReleaseColumns: Additive nullable columns leave current v1 publication fields NULL; existing v1 immutable receipt and workflow history remain unchanged.
conceptualMigrationAssessment.legacySourceRows: Migration does not update supplier_prices. All active old stock/multiple/expiry fields are currently NULL. Inclusive expiry predicates therefore retain the same eligible source set for this baseline date.
conceptualMigrationAssessment.stockZero: New v2 stock0 is informational, distinct fromNULL; current legacy source has no nonnull stock value.
conceptualMigrationAssessment.orderQuantity: New nonnull order_multiple only affects newly supplied commercial terms; existing active source has no such term to alter current behavior.
conceptualMigrationAssessment.rawExport: Supplier raw-source download/preview intentionally includes future and expired fields; effective price/quote readers enforce inclusive valid_to and retain pointer ownership.
conceptualMigrationAssessment.versionInvalidation: New source-version prefixes may change cache keys after apply even when logical prices remain equal; compare semantic hashes, not version-key equality.

runtimeParityObservation.coordinatorReportedNativeStaging: Root observed native V3 Render selecting Node26.12 from catalog engines>=20; this agent did not inspect provider UI.
runtimeParityObservation.recommendation: Pin both catalog native and Docker runtimes to the same exact tested24.15.0, preserving supplier digest for Docker; then rerun catalog crash/recovery tests and deploy staging first.
runtimeParityObservation.coordinatorFollowup: Root reported owning package/lock/Docker pin and nativeV3redeploy; no catalog edit or provider mutation by this agent.

replayQueries.priceTemplate:
with p as(select '1e4c5e99-e387-41aa-a6d3-cbe74558f766'::uuid org,'BRAND_UUID'::uuid brand,'CASE_LABEL'::text label,'LIST_TYPE'::text list_type,MARGIN_VALUE::numeric margin),
ptr as materialized(select t.* from public.supplier_current_price_pointers t cross join p where t.organization_id=p.org and t.brand_id=p.brand),
pub as materialized(select t.* from ptr t join public.supplier_price_publications x on x.id=t.publication_id and x.release_id=t.release_id and x.organization_id=t.organization_id and x.supplier_id=t.supplier_id and x.brand_id=t.brand_id and x.status='published'),
legacy_ranked as materialized(select sp.*,public.normalize_catalog_product_code(sp.product_code) exact_code,
 row_number() over(partition by sp.supplier_id,public.normalize_catalog_product_code(sp.product_code) order by sp.valid_from desc,sp.id::text desc) rn
 from public.supplier_prices sp cross join p where sp.organization_id=p.org and sp.brand_id=p.brand and sp.is_active and sp.buy_price>0 and sp.currency='EUR'
 and sp.valid_from<=current_date and(sp.valid_to is null or sp.valid_to>=current_date)
 and public.normalize_catalog_product_code(sp.product_code)~'[A-Z0-9]'
 and not exists(select 1 from ptr t where t.supplier_id=sp.supplier_id)),
source_rows as materialized(select exact_code normalized_code,product_code,buy_price,valid_from,supplier_id from legacy_ranked where rn=1
 union all select rr.normalized_code,rr.product_code,rr.buy_price,rr.valid_from,t.supplier_id from pub t join public.supplier_price_release_rows rr on rr.release_id=t.release_id
 where rr.row_status='accepted' and rr.buy_price>0 and rr.currency='EUR' and rr.valid_from<=current_date
 and rr.normalized_code=public.normalize_catalog_product_code(rr.product_code) and rr.normalized_code~'[A-Z0-9]'),
golden as materialized(select distinct on(normalized_code collate "C") normalized_code,product_code,buy_price,valid_from,supplier_id
 from source_rows order by normalized_code collate "C",buy_price,valid_from desc,supplier_id),
numbered as(select normalized_code,row_number()over(order by normalized_code collate "C") n,count(*)over() total from golden),
anchors as(select null::text after_code union all select normalized_code from numbered where n%5000=0 and n<total),
actual as materialized(select 'admin' audience,to_jsonb(a) payload from p cross join anchors k cross join lateral public.cloud_admin_price_list_page_fast(p.org,p.brand,p.list_type,p.margin/100,null,k.after_code,5000)a
 union all select 'portal',to_jsonb(a) from p cross join anchors k cross join lateral public.cloud_portal_customer_price_list_page_fast(p.org,p.brand,p.list_type,p.margin,null,k.after_code,5000)a),
stats as(select a.audience,count(*) actual_rows,count(distinct a.payload->>'normalized_code') distinct_codes,
 count(*)filter(where g.normalized_code is null or (a.payload->>'sales_price')::numeric is distinct from round(g.buy_price*(1+p.margin/100),2)
 or (a.payload->>'price_date')::date is distinct from g.valid_from or a.payload->>'price_list_type' is distinct from p.list_type) mismatches,
 max((a.payload->>'total_count')::bigint) reported_total,
 md5(string_agg(md5((a.payload-'total_count')::text),'|' order by a.payload->>'normalized_code' collate "C")) semantic_md5
 from actual a cross join p left join golden g on g.normalized_code=a.payload->>'normalized_code' group by a.audience)
select jsonb_build_object('captured_at',clock_timestamp(),'brand_id',p.brand,'price_case',p.label,'list_type',p.list_type,'margin_percent',p.margin,
 'expected_codes',(select count(*)from golden),'source_supplier_rows',(select count(*)from source_rows),'keyset_anchors',(select count(*)from anchors),
 'golden_price_date_md5',(select md5(string_agg(md5(jsonb_build_array(normalized_code,buy_price,valid_from)::text),'|' order by normalized_code collate "C"))from golden),
 'results',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)order by audience)from stats s)) evidence from p;

limits: Database result parity is not authenticated browser/download delivery proof.
Each statement has its own database snapshot; no long transaction or source lock spans all cases.
Baseline database_date is2026-10-14; crossing a date boundary can legitimately alter eligibility/freshness. Recheck expected date and pointers before comparing hashes.
Full profile checks cover the two requested brands; global inventory checks counts/commercial-field validity, not all-brand price parity.
No orders, source files, releases, decisions, publications, provider configuration or schema were created or changed by these checks.
Postapply rerun must first confirm unchangedGEBA pointer and source hashes; a deliberately published new source requires separate acceptance rather than claiming baseline equality.
